# Romantic Orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RomanticOrientation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A person's SELF-ASSERTED romantic orientation — the pattern of their romantic attraction — as a reified facet pointing (via [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md)) to an open [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md). A SEPARATE axis from sexual orientation (split-attraction model); the two are mutually independent (e.g. asexual yet biromantic).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a person's self-asserted pattern of romantic attraction as a first-class facet — mutually independent of sexual orientation under the split-attraction model, so asexual-yet-biromantic and aromantic-yet-bisexual are directly expressible.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the pattern of sexual attraction (that is [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](gmeow-SexualOrientation.md)) and avoid inferring it from sexual orientation, gender identity, sex assigned at birth, pronouns, or honorifics; reach for the facet rather than a literal on the person.

### How to use

- Mint the facet, link it from the person with [`gmeow:hasRomanticOrientation`](../properties/gmeow-hasRomanticOrientation.md), point it at a [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) via [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md), and tag it [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md); carry the self-identified versus attributed standpoint on the statement layer and supersede with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than deletion.

### Examples

- ex:lillithRomOrient a [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md); [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md) [`gmeow:romanticBiromantic`](../individuals/gmeow-romanticBiromantic.md); [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md).
